arguments.name: ReleaseVersion
arguments.type: exact ASCII 0.1.0-beta.N (N=1..65535, no leading zero), or exact stable 0.1.0; full-string only

backend.temporaryFiles: private bounded sibling work directory; no other published output; retain failed work with PID receipts
backend.metadataTransport: UTF-8 JSON without BOM; exact schema in decision section Input; JSON byte serialization is never an identity input

canonicalEncoding.integer: u32 little-endian except UUID RFC network order and ordinary Windows PE/LNK fields
canonicalEncoding.string: LP(s) = u32le(UTF-8 byte count) followed by UTF-8 bytes; no BOM or terminator; no normalization or locale transforms
canonicalEncoding.guid: uppercase braced 38-character text; UUIDv5 hashes namespace RFC network-order bytes followed by the specified raw name bytes, sets RFC version/variant, formats from network order; never hash Guid.ToByteArray() mixed-endian bytes
canonicalEncoding.inventory: ASCII KWR1 + u32le(row count) + each row's ordered LP fields; sort by ASCII normalizedIdentity ordinal, then id ordinal; reject duplicate normalizedIdentity
canonicalEncoding.build: ASCII KWB2 + LP(schema) + LP(componentSchema) + LP(familyGuid) + LP(architecture) + LP(releaseVersion) + LP(channel) + LP(msiVersion) + LP(commit) + LP(target) + LP(guardAbi) + LP(guardSha256) + u32le(import count) + ordered LP(load),LP(dll) import pairs + u32le(inventory byte count) + inventory bytes
canonicalEncoding.buildId: SHA-256 of build encoding; numeric metadata values encoded as canonical unsigned decimal LP strings
canonicalEncoding.productName: ASCII KWP2 + LP(architecture) + LP(releaseVersion) + LP(channel) + LP(msiVersion) + LP(buildId)
canonicalEncoding.packageCode: fresh cryptographically random UUIDv4 per successful packaging invocation; excluded from BuildID
canonicalEncoding.componentName: ASCII KWC1 + LP(architecture) + LP(resourceKind) + LP(normalizedIdentity) + LP(componentSchema)
canonicalEncoding.componentCode: UUIDv5(component namespace, componentName); resourceKind F or R; K rows use their owning R component
canonicalEncoding.componentIdentifier: C followed by 32 uppercase component UUID hex digits without braces or hyphens
canonicalEncoding.identity: F: root + ':' + ASCII-lower(relative); R: 'H:' + ASCII-lower(relative) + ':' + ASCII-lower(name); K: 'H:' + ASCII-lower(relative) + ':#key'; name is @ for default or n: followed by literal nonempty value name
canonicalEncoding.unusedField: literal hyphen (-), never SQL NULL or empty string; valueType is decimal 0 for non-R and 1 for R
canonicalEncoding.imports: load N (normal) or D (delay), DLL basenames matching [a-z0-9._-]+[.]dll, sorted ordinal by load then dll; duplicate pair forbidden; empty delay list is an explicit zero count

limits.allocationPolicy: check counts and lengths before allocation; checked arithmetic; no input-sized unbounded collection; deadline checked between OS calls, not a promise to interrupt a stalled OS API

msiTables.notation: i2/i4 = nonnullable MSI integer; sN = nonnullable case-sensitive MSI string maximum N; s0 = nonnullable long MSI string additionally bounded here; listed first column is primary key unless primaryKey says otherwise

kinds.F: regular installed file including generated Start Menu LNK
kinds.K: explicit registry key existence; never recursive ownership

sources.p: payload file at Relative under PayloadDirectory; root I only
sources.g: fixed generated start-menu-v1 LNK; root P only

KwilResource.idRule: r followed by 6 zero-padded decimal digits, starting 000001 in normalizedIdentity sort order; File_ F plus same digits for F, Registry_ R plus same digits for R; hyphen otherwise
KwilResource.dataRule: R: exact REG_SZ template with ${I} as the only token, expanding to canonical root I plus one trailing backslash; other literal dollar/braces forbidden except the exact fixed braced familyGuid in file Owner data familyGuid|architecture|1|file-normalizedIdentity; empty string represented by ~empty~; non-R hyphen
KwilResource.keyRule: K: relative key, name/data/size/sha256/source/fileKey/registryKey hyphen, valueType 0; Component_ is the component of the lexicographically first authored R directly in that key; K must have such an R
KwilResource.fileRule: F: name/data/registryKey hyphen, valueType 0; size canonical decimal and sha256 lowercase hex
KwilResource.valueRule: R: root H, size/sha256/source/fileKey hyphen, valueType 1; Name @ or n:literal; Registry_ exact corresponding standard Registry row

KwilGuardImport.semantics: exact normal/delay import DLL evidence for Binary.KwilPreflight, reconstructed by backend PE inspection

mutableOperationAllowlist.REMOVE: empty or ALL; ALL only for registered product including nested old-product uninstall
mutableOperationAllowlist.REINSTALL: empty or ALL; ALL only with original registered PackageCode and REINSTALLMODE=amus
mutableOperationAllowlist.REINSTALLMODE: empty or omus when REINSTALL is empty (install/uninstall); exactly amus for explicit REINSTALL=ALL repair

properties.guardRule: read constants from active database Property table, compare effective session values; ARPINSTALLLOCATION is compared to independently resolved INSTALLDIR, not its database format expression; derive Installed, predecessor and operation authority independently from current-user MSI registration, then require effective Installed presence to agree and ACTION=INSTALL; validate detection properties against independent registration without setting them; effective INSTALLDIR and ProgramMenuFolder must equal OS-derived canonical roots

guard.rustAbi: unsafe extern "system" fn KwilPreflightV2(session: u32) -> u32; no unwind; MSIHANDLE is u32 on both targets
guard.condition: 1 (unconditional execute-sequence guard, also maintenance and nested uninstall)

errorRecord.field2: bounded reason code and resource identity

guard.inputAuthority: active MSI database and independently verified registered cached original package; never command-line KWIL_* detection properties
guard.inUseCheck: Restart Manager observation session: RmStartSession, RmRegisterResources for existing registered kwil.exe and kwil.com, bounded RmGetList, RmEndSession; any affected process or reboot reason or API failure refuses. Also read-only CreateFile sharing probe per pair member; no shutdown/restart API. See decision for precise flags and missing-file behavior.
guard.dependencies: Windows system FFI and already-approved permissive workspace dependencies only; no editor/GPU/TUI/update dependencies; static CRT; no app startup or DllMain work beyond loader-safe initialization

installation.shortcut: nonadvertised deterministic Shell Link installed through File table, generated start-menu-v1; no Shortcut table and no COM; exact 868-byte format in decision
installation.fileComponentKeypath: native64 HKCU Software\Kwil\Installer\{3D9C2C6F-7C59-4D54-92B4-0BA1EC60347A}\Components\<component GUID>, value Owner; REG_SZ familyGuid|architecture|1|file-normalizedIdentity; same component as F row
installation.componentKeypath: Registry identifier for individually declared REG_SZ; every file has its own Owner Registry keypath; no file keypaths
installation.registryRemoval: individual authored Registry rows only; never RemoveRegistry, recursive delete, or special +,-,* Name rows; preserve unknown values/subkeys
installation.removeFile: Mode=2, FileName=NULL, component-associated own implicit install directories deepest first; no wildcard/file-name cleanup; no ProgramMenuFolder removal
installation.createFolder: none; schema1 has no genuine empty-directory resource
installation.explicitRepair: msiexec /i <retained original MSI> REINSTALL=ALL REINSTALLMODE=amus; no advertised/automatic repair

packageAuthoring.cabinetMemberNames: File primary keys only: F followed by six decimal digits; never raw payload names in DDF directives
packageAuthoring.filename: short|long for every File.FileName; Directory.DefaultDir must match the exact decision rows, using short|long only where specified; stable K plus six digits .ext short alias derived from row id; ASCII long names validated; no colon, pipes, bracket, percent, quotes, controls, wildcard characters or reserved DOS names
packageAuthoring.standardRowsCrossCheck: exact bijections from custom inventory to File, Registry, Component and directory ownership; feature Main contains all components, Level 1, Attributes 0, Directory INSTALLDIR, parent NULL; only the Type1 guard and fixed Type51 ARP setter are custom actions; no authored DisableRollback action, services, Environment, Shortcut, RemoveRegistry, wildcard RemoveFile or deferred/external actions
packageAuthoring.staticRuntime: inspect normal and delay PE imports of both entry points and guard; reject dynamic MSVC/UCRT imports under existing scripts/check-static-runtime.py policy, including api-ms-win-crt-*; guard import evidence is independently reconstructed
packageAuthoring.signing: unsigned local artifact; checksums are not signatures; no publication
